mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact homogeneous energy, Friedmann and component/total U1 identities; critical-point elimination and excluded massless flat direction; bounded fully evolved nonlinear Einstein-five-field solution at two tolerances with constraint, energy and charge ledgers
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact real symbolic algebra and float64 DOP853 integration
mathematics.conventions: Five canonical real fields: Psi=(u0+i*u1)/sqrt(2), Chi=(u2+i*u3)/sqrt(2), s=u4. Expanding flat FLRW proper time, a(0)=1, bare Lambda=0. Mpl is the bare cosmological Planck mass. Homogeneous projected z=0, t=1, centered trace QK=0, inactive compensated gate.
inputs: Mpl=100,V0=0.01,M=3,m=1,mu=0.5,gamma=0.2; rotating Psi amplitude 1, rotating Chi amplitude 0.001, s=0.001, sdot=0
non_claims: The bounded computation does not prove infinite-time continuation or attraction; the separate analytic argument does
No inhomogeneous stability, full coupled PDE Cauchy theorem, outward transport or empirical fit
No particle population or phenomenological decay rate
No automatic global timelike scalar phase or conclusion for the contracting branch
The strict positive masses and floor are hypotheses
